mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate compresses discount rates for equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days as investors anticipate cheaper corporate financing and expanded profit margins.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 4.0% for three consecutive months signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending power, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days as earnings expectations decline.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 4.0% for 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad consumer demand contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days as recession risks escalate.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative returns when correlation with SPX returns is below 0.05 in 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL > 6.0% YoY) forces the Fed to maintain restrictive policy, reducing equity valuations and generating negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 6.0% YoY.

mechanism_narrative: Monthly nonfarm payrolls growth above 100k signals robust labor market strength that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months with PAYEMS growth exceeding 100k.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production falling below 100 for two consecutive months indicates manufacturing contraction, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days as economic slowdown fears intensify.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO is below 100 for two months.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent quarterly GDP contraction (GDPC1 < 0%) and housing starts decline (HOUST < 1350k) signal deepening economic weakness, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in GDPC1 and HOUST fails to predict negative returns when correlation with SPX returns is below 0.05 in 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Late-cycle retail sales growth exceeding 3.0% YoY signals overextended consumer spending, prompting negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days as recession risks rise.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS growth exceeds 3.0% YoY.
